state.catalog_context: Supplier product catalog for industrial robotics and automation equipment

instructions.question: Which standard product field does the supplier spreadsheet column `column` hold?

criteria.sku: Unique product identifier, e.g. part number, product code, SKU or item code
criteria.name: Human-readable product name, title or description
criteria.unit_price: Price of ONE single unit (not an extended, line or order total)
criteria.currency: Currency code or currency name that the prices are quoted in
criteria.payload_kg: Payload or rated load: the mass the product can carry or lift
criteria.reach_m: Reach: the maximum working distance or arm length
criteria.irrelevant: None of the above, e.g. warranty, stock location, lead time, quantity or totals
